title: Messinian salinity crisis
summary: During the Messinian salinity crisis the Mediterranean's connection to the Atlantic was restricted, and evaporites formed first in shallow sub-basins and then in the deepest basins. Onset is dated to 5.96 ± 0.02 Ma. The crisis ended about 5.33 million years ago, when Atlantic water refilled the basin through the Gibraltar Strait in the Zanclean flood.

uncertainty.note: Onset 5.96 ± 0.02 Ma; Roveri et al. also cite a refined 5.97 Ma (Manzi et al. 2013). End 5.33 Ma is the Zanclean base and reflooding age.

where.modern_name: Mediterranean Sea basin (pin at the Strait of Gibraltar)
where.historical_name: Mediterranean basin, Late Miocene; no polities

importance.justification: A basin-wide salinity and sea-level crisis that transformed the Mediterranean and ended in a catastrophic reflooding.
